content: अप् {%f.%} [आप्-क्विप्-ह्रस्वश्च <ls>Uṇ. 2. 58</ls>] (Declined in classical language only in <ab>pl.</ab>; आपः, अपः, अद्भिः, अद्भ्यः, अपाम् and अप्सु, but in singular and <ab>pl.</ab> in Veda) .²1 Water (regarded in <ab>Ved.</ab> as sacred divinities, आपो देवीः); खानि चैव स्पृशेदद्भिः <ls>Ms. 2. 60</ls>. Water is generally considered to be the first of the 5 elements of creation, as in अप एव ससर्जादौ तासु बीजमवासृजत् <ls>Ms. 1. 8</ls>; या सृष्टिः स्रष्टुराद्या <ls>Ś. 1. 1</ls>; but in <ls>Ms. 1. 78</ls> it is said to have been created from ज्योतिस् or तेजस् after मनस्, आकाश, वायु and ज्योतिस् or अग्नि; ज्योतिषश्च विकुर्वाणादापो रसगुणाः स्मृताः . अद्भ्यो गन्धगुणा भूमिरित्येषा सृष्टिरादितः .. .²2 Air, the intermediate region. .²3 The star S virginis (चित्रा). For the changes of अप् at the end of <ab>comp.</ab> See <ls>P. V. 4. 74</ls>, <ls n="P.">VI. 3. 97-98</ls>.
